scientific_scope_status: For a rectangular circuit with some square quadratic coordinate projection having at most 2^ceil(n/2) missing outputs, a uniform FP^NP algorithm acquires a noncollision affine flat of codimension at most five and returns a missing rectangular output. The useful projection, hole count, Fourier spectrum, factorization and full collision list are not given as advice; repeated fibers are allowed. For dense explicit quadratic input, conservative counts are O(n^7) ordinary NP decisions and O(n^33) other bit work; NP-solving time is not polynomial-time ordinary computation. General Avoid, P vs NP, practical runtime and priority remain unresolved; followups are separately unreviewed.
